G1_hero.h1: SATLARS — laboratory automation systems from Snibe
G1_hero.lead: SATLARS is a range of Snibe laboratory automation systems for sample transport, preparation and tracking. This page covers three systems: SATLARS-T8, SATLARS-TCA and the compact SATLARS mini-T8, which occupies 2.2 m². The SATLARS-T8 and SATLARS-TCA configurations are selected for the laboratory workflow.

image.alt: SATLARS laboratory automation systems from Snibe

items.title: SATLARS-T8
items.text: Sample transport and preparation with a bidirectional four-lane transport system.

items.title: SATLARS-TCA
items.text: A configurable system with RFID sample tracking.

items.title: SATLARS mini-T8
items.text: A compact system from sample loading to storage, 2.2 m².

SATLARS-T8 is a modular Snibe laboratory automation system for sample transport and preparation. Its bidirectional four-lane transport system prioritizes urgent samples, and a continuous centrifuge with two manipulators helps organize sample preparation. The configuration can be adapted to the laboratory workflow.

SATLARS-TCA is a Snibe laboratory automation system that combines sample-handling steps in a configurable layout. RFID provides sample tracking within the system, and automated operations reduce the need to move samples by hand. Snibe states that the system was developed jointly with Thermo Fisher.

SATLARS mini-T8 is a compact automated Snibe system covering the sample path from loading to storage. Its sample processing unit combines 14 functions, while a camera with sample recognition and automatic quality control support the workflow. The footprint is 2.2 m².
